_comment: VOX configuration. Confidence is gated PER CRITICAL FIELD (entity match, next_meeting date, register writes). Non-critical fields (discussion points, commitments, attendees, note prose) never block an auto-write.

google._comment: Per-user OAuth. Each RM signs in with their own Google account; writes land in their own Drive+Calendar. Refresh tokens are stored server-side keyed to the ATLAS rm id (see vocx_oauth.TokenStore).
google._note: drive_enabled off by default — the ATLAS log already carries the interaction; Drive only adds a note document + team folder + transcript archive. Turn it on (and add the drive scope below) if you want those.

stt._comment: Speech-to-text. backend: api (the dedicated PRISM STT service — the compose/Helm default) | faster_whisper (in-process; needs the [stt] extra) | stub (tests). task translate = capture in ANY language, store ENGLISH (Whisper translates; the spoken language is still recorded). model_size only applies in-process; the STT service bakes its own model.

_report_templates_note: Extra Additional-details fields, composed from the matched business-line template + the matched sector template. axis=business_line matches report.business_line exactly; axis=sector matches if any 'match' token is a substring of report.sector (lowercased). Add/edit freely — the app renders these dynamically. field.type: text (default) | number | date | select(+options).
_integration_note: PRISM VocX defaults. Deployment concerns (Google client secret path, redirect URI, tokens dir, STT backend, Anthropic key) come from VOCX_* / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env vars via app.vocx.loader — never from this file. Thresholds/templates are tuning, edit freely.
_stt_vocabulary_note: stt.vocabulary primes Whisper (initial_prompt) so domain terms and client names are HEARD correctly. VocX appends the live Register client/lead names after these terms (names last — Whisper reads only the prompt's tail). Edit freely; no rebuild needed beyond restart.
glossary: Evam Finance is an Indian climate-finance intermediary. Amounts are in INR; 1 crore (Cr) = 10 million, 1 lakh = 100,000.

Business lines: LENDING (Evam arranges/underwrites debt for a client; stages: Data Awaited, Diligence, Note Circulated, Sanctioned, CP/CS Completed, Ready for Disbursement, Handed Over to Advaya), SYNDICATION (Evam places a client's debt requirement with other lenders/NBFCs/banks; statuses: Deal Sourced, Docs Pending, IM in Prep, IM Circulated, Queries Received, IP Received, Sanctioned, Disbursed), ASSET MONETISATION (selling/monetising operating assets; statuses: Teaser Prepared, Teaser Shared, In Discussion, NBO Received).

Jargon: IM = Information Memorandum (deal document circulated to lenders); IP = In-Principle approval; NBO = Non-Binding Offer; CAM = Credit Assessment Memo; CP/CS = Conditions Precedent / Conditions Subsequent; DSCR = Debt Service Coverage Ratio; tenor = loan duration; moratorium = repayment holiday; sanction = lender's formal approval; disbursement = money released.

Sector jargon: PPA = Power Purchase Agreement; SECI = Solar Energy Corporation of India; discom = power distribution company; ALMM = Approved List of Models & Manufacturers (solar); VGF = Viability Gap Funding; CBG = Compressed Biogas; BESS = Battery Energy Storage; EPC = Engineering/Procurement/Construction contractor; offtaker = the buyer of the project's output; WASH = Water/Sanitation/Hygiene.

When the RM says a lender 'has the IM' or 'queries came back', that is SYNDICATION activity (business_line_hint=syn) and usually a lender_update. 'Sanction', 'CAM', 'credit committee', 'disbursement' talk is LENDING (lend). 'Teaser', 'NBO', 'asset sale' talk is ASSET MONETISATION (am).

few_shot_examples.transcript: Met Suresh from GreenVolt Energy about their 25 megawatt solar project in Karnataka. They need a 40 crore term loan, 12 year tenor with a 6 month moratorium. Their DSCR looks comfortable at 1.4. CAM goes to credit committee next week. They'll send the audited financials by Thursday. Set a review call next Wednesday at noon.

few_shot_examples.label: syndication lender chase
few_shot_examples.transcript: Quick note — spoke to Axis about the Meghdoot Hydro IM we circulated. Queries came back on the offtaker PPA, they want the discom payment track record. Kotak has gone quiet, chase them Friday. Meghdoot side, nothing new.

Kotak silent since IM circulation — chase <Friday resolved>

few_shot_examples.label: asset monetisation teaser
few_shot_examples.transcript: Sat with the Vertex Renewables CFO. They want to monetise their operating 50 megawatt wind portfolio in Tamil Nadu, expecting around 300 crores. We'll prepare the teaser by month end. He hinted two InvITs already sniffing around, so move fast. Hot one.

report.title: Vertex Renewables
report.summary: The Vertex Renewables CFO wants to monetise their operating 50 MW Tamil Nadu wind portfolio at ~₹300 Cr. Evam prepares the teaser by month end; two InvITs are already circling, so speed matters.
key_intel: Monetising operating 50 MW wind portfolio, Tamil Nadu — expectation ~₹300 Cr
Competitive pressure: two InvITs already engaged

_intelligence_note: Feature flags for the Batch-1 intelligence upgrades — each independently switchable. In PRISM deployments the ENV VARS win (VOCX_STT_PRIMING, VOCX_EXTRACT_GLOSSARY, VOCX_EXTRACT_FEW_SHOT, VOCX_EXTRACT_STRUCTURED); this block is only the default for standalone/vendored use. Disabling a flag reverts that one feature to pre-Batch-1 behaviour.
_completeness_note: What a report must carry before it is filed, and what merely helps. The APPROVE screen reads this: a missing required field is named and blocks the default action; a missing optional one is named and can be waived. Declared here, not in the client, so the bar can be raised without shipping a new UI. 'path' is read from the extraction's report object unless it names another root; kind=list means non-empty.
